## X-Sense Home Security v1.6.2

### Device Test Diagnostics
- Restores the Device Test Result and Device Test Time diagnostic entities for SWS51 water leak sensors and other test-capable devices.
- Keeps those diagnostic entities available before the next physical test report arrives, so automations can keep using the same entity IDs.

### Cloud Credential Refresh
- Clears the complete AWS credential and signing bundle whenever the X-Sense Cognito session refreshes.
- Obtains fresh credentials before the next station shadow request, matching the X-Sense app's credential-provider reset.

### Recordings
- Uses UTC explicitly when formatting cached recording clip titles.
